title: Vertex-critical co-gem-free graphs
summary: Given a graph $G$, let $χ(G)$ denote the chromatic number of $G$. For $k\in \mathbb{N}$, a graph $G$ is $k$-$vertex$-$critical$ if $χ(G)=k$ and $χ(G-v)< k$ for all $v\in V(G)$. A recent problem of Beaton and Cameron [TCS 1042 (2025) 115234] asks for which graphs $H$ of order five, are there finitely many $k$-vertex-critical (co-gem, $H$)-free graphs, for all $k\in \mathbb{N}$? Here we identify three distinct graphs on five vertices that yield an affirmative answer to this problem.
